title: Grade 3 Maths — Mon, May 18
description: Place Value — Hundreds, Tens, Ones — Last Week Day 1
subject: mathematics

questions.question: What is the value of the digit 5 in the number 352?
questions.explanation: In 352, the digit 5 is in the tens place, so its value is 5 × 10 = 50.

questions.question: What is the digit in the hundreds place of 476?
questions.explanation: In 476: 4 is in the hundreds, 7 is in the tens, 6 is in the ones.

questions.question: Which number has 3 hundreds, 5 tens, and 8 ones?
What is 200 + 40 + 7?
questions.explanation: 200 + 40 + 7 = 247. This is expanded form to standard form.

questions.question: What is the expanded form of 563?
questions.explanation: 563 = 500 + 60 + 3. This shows the value of each digit.

questions.question: Which number is GREATEST?
questions.explanation: 594 is greatest — start by comparing hundreds: 5 > 4. Then 594 > 549 (compare tens: 9 > 4).

questions.question: How many tens are there in 230?
questions.explanation: 230 = 23 tens (230 ÷ 10 = 23). There are 23 groups of 10 in 230.

questions.question: What is 10 more than 385?
questions.explanation: 10 more than 385 = 385 + 10 = 395. Only the tens digit changes.

questions.question: Round 357 to the nearest hundred.
questions.explanation: 357: the hundreds digit is 3, the tens digit is 5. Since 5 ≥ 5, round UP to 400.

questions.question: Write 900 + 4 as a number.
questions.explanation: 900 + 4 = 904. The 0 in the tens place is a placeholder.

questions.question: Which symbol makes this true? 461 ___ 416
questions.explanation: 461 > 416. Compare tens: 6 tens > 1 ten. So 461 is greater.

questions.question: Which of these numbers is the smallest?
Round 245 to the nearest 10.
questions.explanation: 245: ones digit is 5. Since 5 ≥ 5, round UP the tens: 245 → 250.
